# Chrome Web Store Listing Copy — TimeOnChrome v1.7.5

## Short Description
TimeOnChrome helps families manage Chrome use with study modes, usage analysis, site requests, quotas, and clear diagnostics.

## Detailed Description
TimeOnChrome is a Chrome time-management assistant for families and students. It helps parents define when study, composite, and rest browsing are allowed, review usage by managed object, approve or reject website classification requests, and keep device behavior transparent.

### What's new in v1.7.5
- Refreshed product icon system across the extension, local Admin, Popup, Reminder, and cloud console.
- New cloud console structure: 使用统计, 访问管理, 网站归类申请, 子用户管理, and 系统管理.
- Configuration import now shows differences before applying changes, including added, deleted, and modified site, quota, and time-window settings.
- Account sessions now use refresh tokens. New clients no longer store reversible account passwords, and password changes do not unbind already registered terminals.
- Timing diagnostics now include checkpoint health, ledger-gap detection, and mode-transition audit logs.
- YouTube classification requests use canonical playlist/video URLs as a temporary compatibility policy.

### Core features
- Screen Time style usage statistics for web usage and media usage.
- Study, composite, rest, locked, and paused runtime states.
- Website management for study sites, composite sites, restricted entertainment, blocked sites, and canonical URL rules.
- Website classification requests from the child terminal with parent review in the cloud console.
- Daily quotas and mode time-window controls.
- Device management and long-lived terminal binding.
- Local and cloud diagnostics for timing settlement, checkpoint health, and sync issues.

### Privacy summary
TimeOnChrome stores only the data needed for time management, site classification, quota enforcement, diagnostics, and optional cloud sync. The extension does not collect page content, passwords, comments, or private messages. Incognito fallback/unmanaged records are sanitized before durable storage and upload.
